author: bd-spin/bd-spin-20260511T170438Z-856615
text: Adding 'human' label so do-beads autonomous loop skips this. The bead description already says 'Filed as opinion-tagged so the loop converges and the call lands with the human, not the agent.' — the opinion tag works for bd-review-loop convergence but do-beads filters only on the 'human' label. The parent JMAP-sc1b is itself 'human'-labeled, so this matches the parent's routing intent.
